sentences.en: RECEPTIONIST: Good afternoon, Dreamtime Travel
sentences.zh: RECEPTIONIST: 下午好，梦幻时光旅行社。

sentences.en: How can I help you?
sentences.zh: 有什么可以帮您的吗？

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: Oh hello
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 哦，你好。

sentences.en: I'm interested in the holidays you offer along the coast near here
sentences.zh: 我对你们在附近沿海地区提供的度假项目很感兴趣。

sentences.en: RECEPTIONIST: Yes
sentences.zh: RECEPTIONIST: 是的。

sentences.en: We operate several tours up the coast
sentences.zh: 我们运营多条沿海观光线路。

sentences.en: Where in particular did you want to go?
sentences.zh: 您具体想去哪个地方呢？

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: Well, I like the sound of the holiday that mentioned whales
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 嗯，我对提到鲸鱼的那个度假项目很感兴趣。

sentences.en: Was it 'Whale Watching'?
sentences.zh: 是叫‘观鲸之旅’吗？

sentences.en: RECEPTIONIST: Oh, that's our Whale Watch Experience
sentences.zh: RECEPTIONIST: 哦，那是我们的‘观鲸体验之旅’。

sentences.en: It's very popular and it's Example based in a lovely little town with nice beaches
sentences.zh: 它非常受欢迎，以一个风景优美、拥有宜人海滩的小镇为基地。

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: Oh right, and how long does it last?
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 哦，明白了。那这个行程持续多久？

sentences.en: RECEPTIONIST: It's two days - that includes four hours' travel time each way from here
sentences.zh: RECEPTIONIST: 行程为期两天——其中包括往返各四小时的交通时间。

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: Good, I don't want to be away any longer than that
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 很好，我并不想离开超过这么长时间。

sentences.en: So is that by coach?
sentences.zh: 那么，是乘坐长途大巴吗？

sentences.en: RECEPTIONIST: Actually it's by minibus
sentences.zh: RECEPTIONIST: 实际上是乘坐小型巴士。

sentences.en: We like to keep those tours small and personal so we don't take a whole coachload of people
sentences.zh: 我们希望这些旅行团规模小一些、更具个性化，因此不会安排整辆大巴的游客。

sentences.en: In fact, we only take up to fifteen people on this tour, although we do run it with just twelve or thirteen
sentences.zh: 事实上，该线路最多只接待十五人，通常实际出行人数为十二至十三人。

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: Oh, right
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 哦，明白了。

sentences.en: So do you run these tours often?
sentences.zh: 那么，这些旅行团经常组织吗？

sentences.en: RECEPTIONIST: Well it depends on the time of year
sentences.zh: RECEPTIONIST: 这取决于一年中的不同季节。

sentences.en: Of course in peak times like the summer holidays we do them every weekend, but at the moment it's usually once a month at most
sentences.zh: 当然，在暑期等旅游旺季，我们每周末都发团；但目前最多每月仅组织一次。

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: And when is the next one going?
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 那下一次是什么时候出发？

sentences.en: RECEPTIONIST: Mmm, let me sec
sentences.zh: RECEPTIONIST: 嗯，让我查一下。

sentences.en: Um, there's one in three weeks' time which is April the 18th, and then we don't have another one until June the 2nd. 03
sentences.zh: 呃，三周后有一次，即4月18日；之后的下一次要等到6月2日了。

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: All right, and is April a good time to go?
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 好的，那么四月去合适吗？

sentences.en: RECEPTIONIST: Pretty good
sentences.zh: RECEPTIONIST: 相当合适。

sentences.en: Though the really good time is later in the year
sentences.zh: 不过，真正最佳的观鲸时间是在一年中更晚些时候。

sentences.en: have to say though that the whale sighting is only one of the many things offered
sentences.zh: 不过我得说明，观鲸只是此次行程所提供的众多活动之一。

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: Really?
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 真的吗？

sentences.en: RECEPTIONIST: Yes
sentences.zh: RECEPTIONIST: 是的。

sentences.en: The hotel itself where you stay has great facilities
sentences.zh: 您入住的酒店本身设施就很出色。

sentences.en: It's called The Pallisades
sentences.zh: 它叫‘帕利塞兹酒店’（The Palisades）。

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: The Paris what?
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 巴黎什么？

sentences.en: RECEPTIONIST: No, it's actually The Palisades, P-A-L-L-1-S-A-D-E-S
sentences.zh: RECEPTIONIST: 不，是‘帕利塞兹’（The Palisades），拼写为P-A-L-L-I-S-A-D-E-S。

sentences.en: It's right on the main beach there
sentences.zh: 它就坐落在那里的主海滩上。

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: Oh, I see
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 哦，我明白了。

sentences.en: Test l 7. 3-10
sentences.zh: 测试卷7 第3–10题

sentences.en: RECEPTIONIST: All of the rooms have nice views and the food is really good there too
sentences.zh: RECEPTIONIST: 所有客房均享有优美景观，那里的餐饮也非常棒。

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: Oh right
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 哦，明白了。

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: And what about the other things?
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 那其他活动呢？

sentences.en: You know, that are included in the price
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些都包含在价格内。

sentences.en: RECEPTIONIST: Oh, there are lots of things
sentences.zh: RECEPTIONIST: 哦，项目可多了。

sentences.en: If you don't want to do the whale watch cruise, your guide will take anyone who is interested either on a bushwalk through the national park near the hotel, and there's no 05/06 extra charge for that, or on a fishing trip
sentences.zh: 如果您不想参加观鲸游船活动，您的导游会带任何有兴趣的客人前往酒店附近的国家公园进行丛林徒步，这项活动不额外收费；或者也可以组织钓鱼之旅。

sentences.en: That's an extra $12 I think
sentences.zh: 我想那要额外收取12美元。

sentences.en: And there's also a reptile park in town - that costs more or less the same
sentences.zh: 镇上还有一座爬行动物公园——费用大致相同。

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: No, I think I'd prefer whales to snakes
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 不，我想我更愿意看鲸鱼，而不是蛇。

sentences.en: RECEPTIONIST: Yeah
sentences.zh: RECEPTIONIST: 是啊。

sentences.en: And if you just want to relax you are free to sit by the hotel pool or go down the beach
sentences.zh: 如果您只想放松一下，可以自由地坐在酒店泳池边，或去海滩。

sentences.en: Oh, and they also have tennis courts at the hotel, but you have to pay for those by the hour
sentences.zh: 哦，酒店还有网球场，但需按小时付费。

sentences.en: But there are table tennis tables downstairs and they're part of the 05/06 accommodation package
sentences.zh: 不过，楼下的乒乓球桌是包含在住宿套餐中的。

sentences.en: Just speak to your guide
sentences.zh: 只需跟您的导游说一声即可。

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: Well that sounds good
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 嗯，这听起来不错。

sentences.en: So how much is the basic tour price?
sentences.zh: 那么基础旅游套餐的价格是多少？

sentences.en: RECEPTIONIST: At this time of year it's usually around $300 but let me check
sentences.zh: RECEPTIONIST: 这个季节通常为300美元左右，让我查一下。

sentences.en: Er…..oh, it's actually $280
sentences.zh: 呃……哦，实际上是280美元。

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: And the next tour, are there any places on that one?
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 下一期旅游团还有空位吗？

sentences.en: RECEPTIONIST: How many people is it for?
sentences.zh: RECEPTIONIST: 您一共几位？

sentences.en: CUSTOMER There are two of us
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 我们两人。

sentences.en: RECEPTIONIST: Yes, that should be fine
sentences.zh: RECEPTIONIST: 是的，应该没问题。

sentences.en: Can I just mention that we require all bookings to be made at least fourteen days before you travel to avoid cancellations of tours
sentences.zh: 另外我想提醒您，为避免旅游团被取消，所有预订须至少在您出发前十四天完成。

sentences.en: And if you cancel within seven days of departure you will have to pay 50% of your total booking
sentences.zh: 若您在出发前七天内取消预订，则需支付全部预订金额的50%。

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: OK
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 好的。

sentences.en: RECEPTIONIST: And you also need to pay a 20% deposit at the time of booking
sentences.zh: RECEPTIONIST: 此外，您在预订时还需支付20%的定金。

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: Can I pay that by credit card?
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 我能用信用卡支付吗？

sentences.en: RECEPTIONIST: Yes, you can
sentences.zh: RECEPTIONIST: 可以。

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: All right, what I'll do is I'll talk to my partner and get back to you
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 好的，那我先跟我的同伴商量一下，再给您回电。

sentences.en: RECEPTIONIST: Fine
sentences.zh: RECEPTIONIST: 没问题。

sentences.en: So I'll make a provisional booking, shall 1? - two for the Whale Watch Experience
sentences.zh: 那我先为您做一份临时预订——两位参加‘观鲸体验’旅游项目，可以吗？

sentences.en: Let me issue you with a customer reference number for when you call back
sentences.zh: 我来为您开具一个客户参考编号，以便您回电时使用。

sentences.en: Do you have a pen?
sentences.zh: 您有笔吗？

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: Yes
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 有。

sentences.en: RECEPTIONIST: OK, it's three nine seven, four five, T
sentences.zh: RECEPTIONIST: 好的，编号是39745T。

sentences.en: That's T for tango
sentences.zh: T代表“tango”（塔戈）。

sentences.en: When you call back, ask to speak to the Tour Manager, that's me, Tracy
sentences.zh: 您回电时请要求转接旅游经理，也就是我，特蕾西。

sentences.en: CUSTOMER: Fine, I will
sentences.zh: CUSTOMER: 好的，我会的。
